aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but invalidly merges several unrelated investigations into one changed factor.
issues: Changed factor combines yoke class, head height, jig repair, mold, and C2/E2 assembly tests.
Baseline and test conditions are incoherent and include dates, heads, classes, and process changes as peers.
Review title and purpose/content come from different sections.
Outcomes include unjudged artifact metrics and Sheet3 context with unclear condition evidence.
Comparisons do not preserve key grouping such as date, line, head, class, lot, and test section.
correctionPlan: Split into separate review cases by test section or supported primary change.
Define one baseline and one changed-condition family per case.
Rebuild comparisons only within the same table and compatible grouping keys.
Remove metrics or measurements not tied to a clear changed condition.
Cite each retained case with its header, condition rows, and paired result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are not sufficient for final evidence because grouping context is invalid.
